name: Loughborough University
summary: A campus university in the Midlands town of Loughborough, with courses from sport science to industrial design, many with a placement year.

ib.text: The full Diploma with at least three HL subjects; each course sets points and HL grades, e.g. 34 (6,5,5 HL) for Industrial Design and 37–38 (6,6,6–7,6,6 HL) for Sport and Exercise Science.

dates.label: UCAS equal consideration deadline, 18:00 UK time

programmes.name: Sport and Exercise Science
programmes.about: Physiology, biochemistry, biomechanics, motor control and psychology behind human performance, in specialist labs on a campus with elite athlete programmes, plus a research project and an optional placement year.
programmes.ib: 37-38 points (6,6,6 to 7,6,6 at HL), including two of Biology, Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Psychology or Sport, Exercise and Health Science at HL.

needs.note: Two of these subjects at HL

programmes.selectionNote: Usually decided on the UCAS application alone; offers come with an invitation to visit. GCSE Maths, English and a science at grade 6 are also required.

flagshipSource.title: Sport and Exercise Science: elite athlete programmes and a Coach and Volunteer Academy on campus (course page)

programmes.name: Industrial Design
programmes.about: Design products for people: research, ideation, model making and CAD in year 1, design for manufacture in year 2, then a year-long self-directed project, with an optional paid placement year in industry.
programmes.ib: 34 points with 6,5,5 at HL. An electronic portfolio is required with your UCAS application.
programmes.selectionNote: You must submit an electronic portfolio; the School publishes portfolio guidance. GCSE Maths and English at grade 4.

flagshipSource.title: Industrial Design: core design skills, a placement year and a year-long major project (course page)

programmes.name: Aeronautical Engineering
programmes.about: Sustainable propulsion, autonomous flight, aircraft systems and computational fluid dynamics, with a flight test module of up to four flights in a flying laboratory and a final-year aircraft design project.
programmes.ib: 35 points with 6,6,5 at HL, including Maths and Physics at HL.

needs.note: The page says Maths and does not name AA or AI

programmes.selectionNote: Usually decided on the UCAS application alone; an interview only in exceptional cases. Accredited by the RAeS and IMechE.

flagshipSource.title: Aeronautical Engineering: a flight test module in a flying laboratory, accredited by RAeS and IMechE (course page)

notes: International fees for 2027-28 are £31,500 a year for Industrial Design and £35,000 for Sport and Exercise Science.
Design courses ask for an electronic portfolio alongside your UCAS application.
A placement year after year 2 earns an extra Diploma in Professional Studies; over 90% of Design students on placement are paid.

faculties.name: School of Aeronautical, Automotive, Chemical and Materials Engineering
faculties.line: Aeronautical Engineering asks HL Maths and Physics, 35 points with 6,6,5; courses offer a placement year.

faculties.name: School of Architecture, Building and Civil Engineering
faculties.line: Built-environment courses from architecture to civil engineering, built with industry; each sets its own IB points.

faculties.name: School of Mechanical, Electrical and Manufacturing Engineering
faculties.line: Industry-focused engineering courses, each with its own IB points and HL subjects.

faculties.name: Loughborough Business School
faculties.line: Degrees stress ethical, sustainable business and hands-on experience in real organisations.

faculties.name: School of Design and Creative Arts
faculties.line: Practical courses; Industrial Design asks 34 points with 6,5,5 at HL and an electronic portfolio.

faculties.name: School of Science
faculties.line: Every course offers a placement year; Foundation Studies courses exist for those short of subjects or grades.

faculties.name: School of Social Sciences and Humanities
faculties.line: A single-campus school with over 4,000 international alumni; each course page sets its own IB offer.

faculties.name: School of Sport, Exercise and Health Sciences
faculties.line: Biosciences, psychology and sport; Sport and Exercise Science asks 37-38 points with two HL sciences.
